a.xlink:title: Solves an OMT source with default options and returns one result per check.
Solves with solver/1, executable/1, and time_limit/1 options. OptiMathSAT rejects nonzero time limits.
Generates and prints a source without invoking a solver.
Generates source character codes without invoking a solver.
Returns the status of a result.
Prints a result and its objectives.
Enumerates objective expressions and exact solver-reported bounds from a get-objectives response.
